issue.title: quarkus-generated-openapi-doc.YAM missing

labels.name: triage/duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

issue.body:
Hello Quarkus community,

**Describe the bug**
I tried to use the `smallrye-openapi` plugin to serve openapi API description and swagger UI without success. So I fall back to the tutorial and I can't get working neither. So I tried to the sample `using-openapi-swaggerui` and it doesn't seem to work too.

The main issue I have is the `quarkus-generated-openapi-doc.YAM` seems missing.
```2019-06-05 10:22:02,206 WARN  [io.und.ser.request] (executor-thread-1) UT015022: Requested resource at /quarkus-generated-openapi-doc.YAML does not exist for include method```

**Expected behavior**
* `http://localhost:8080/openapi` should serve a basic yaml file (according the tutorial),
* `http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui` should display a Swagger UI.

**Actual behavior**
* `http://localhost:8080/openapi` returns a 500 error,
* `http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui` return a 404 error.

body:
@clochardpagan when you say `Also it's strange that when I'm not adding this line, openapi is still available in production - not sure how safe is this.`, we agree that you're only talking about openapi, not Swagger UI?

The OpenAPI extension has always been designed to be, well, open. Only Swagger UI is limited to dev mode if you don't explicitly enable it.

issue.title: Fix regression around OpenAPI not working in dev mode anymore
